paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Financial QA-1 evaluation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance of four different Large Language Models (LLMs) on the Financial QA-1 evaluation, categorized by the type of response provided. The horizontal axis lists the model names: Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B, EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, RedWhale (our), and Partially Correct. The vertical axis represents the evaluation scores, ranging from 0 to 1, with a linear scale and tick labels spaced by 0.1. The score axis is labeled “Score” and the values range from 0.04 to 0.96.  The bar for Llama-3-Open-Ko-8B is purple and has a height of 0.88, the bar for EEVe-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 is blue and has a height of 0.96, the bar for RedWhale (our) is purple and has a height of 0.96, and the bar for Partially Correct is light blue and has a height of 0.08.  All bars are aligned and sorted from left to right based on the model names, and there are no bars visually emphasized. The bars are stacked, with the bottom section representing “Correct” responses, the middle section representing “Partially Correct” responses, and the top section representing “Incorrect” responses.
